task_prompt: Fix the borrow-checker error using interior mutability. The Counter struct should support `increment` through a shared reference (`&self`, not `&mut self`). Return the complete corrected program in a single ```rust code block.
notes: Cannot mutate self.n through &self. Fix: wrap n in Cell<i32> (since i32 is Copy). Use self.n.set(self.n.get() + 1) and self.n.get().
